_help: Global settings. reference_ratio is only the monthly ESTIMATE; the binding settlement is recomputed after Dec 31 from actual ratio income (subcategories with ratio_income=true in categories.json, currently salary only). income_owner 'couple' counts 50/50 to each side. currencies lists what the cash/edit forms offer; EUR is always the base, others must be ECB reference currencies (USD, GBP, CHF, BRL, ...). If the currencies key is ABSENT it defaults to the legacy [EUR, BRL, USD] (backward compatibility for configs created before this key existed); an explicitly present list means exactly what it says. household_name is optional; when absent/blank the footer shows 'Family Accountability'. language is the UI language (default 'en'; 'de' ships built-in) and is editable in the Settings tab.
